In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], former [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Lumiya]] '''confronted''' the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Flint]] in the one-time residence of the recently deceased [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] for the right to [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Mastery]]. Lumiya proved the stronger of the two and soundly defeated Flint, forcing the latter to become the first [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] in her fledgling [[Lumiya's Sith|Sith Order]].<ref name="ENDTSD" />
